mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN GROUP_BUY gb ON gb.group_buy_id = ( SELECT gb2.group_buy_id FROM GROUP_BUY gb2 WHERE gb2.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY gb2.group_buy_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.sale_type, p.brand, p.product_name, p.product_name_jp, p.description, p.price_jpy, p.original_price_jpy, p.stock, p.sales_count, p.weight, p.original_url, p.thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN gb.group_buy_id IS NULL THEN p.status WHEN gb.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN gb.status WHEN gb.current_quantity >= gb.target_quantity THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN gb.end_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'FAILED' WHEN gb.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN 'CLOSING_SOON' ELSE gb.status END AS status, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM PRODUCT p
ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(gb.created_at, p.created_at) DESC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY p.price_jpy ASC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY p.product_id ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
